traditional: A hard contact. Communication, commerce, and contracts works against growth, fortune, and patronage - obstruction, friction, and strained outcomes in these areas.
modern: Mind meets expansion. Easy movement between the big picture and the fine detail, with an optimistic cast to communication. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Exaggeration, and swinging between getting lost in detail and ignoring it entirely. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for thinking against growth, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the thinking/growth form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Strong for pairing vision with persuasion; watch overstatement.
shadow: Scattered overthinking collides with excess and overreach; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.

readerCopy.summary: The headline promises more than the supporting information can defend.
readerCopy.body: The headline promises more than the supporting information can defend. A report, pitch, or announcement jumps from one promising result to a sweeping conclusion while the sample, cost, and exceptions remain buried. Mercury keeps returning to the exact claim, while Jupiter expands the meaning until the message reaches far beyond what was proven. The square turns every missing detail into a challenge to the larger story. The idea may keep circulating, but confidence starts to look careless once people compare the claim with the record.
